_comment: Cross-host H2H gate floors. Regenerate on the multi-host runner with the
h2h_multihost_baselines.json from the run's BAP artifact, keep only the P=1
gate config (1048576B_x64_P1), and commit it here.
sigma_k / max_margin : floor = max(median - sigma_k * MAD_sigma, median * (1 - max_margin))
configs[label]       : baseline_gbs (median when recorded, reference only),
Only 1048576B_x64_P1 carries a throughput floor (max_margin = 0.10). P > 1
gate configs (1048576B_x64_P8, 1048573B_x64_P4) are intentionally omitted so
the gate enforces cross-host byte-integrity (NO FLOOR) without flapping on
multi-stream TCP 5-tuple flow hashing variance across GKE pods.
